messages.subject: FIRMA error message after aroma.affymetrix v1.2.0 install
parts:
I just installed the aroma.affymetrix v1.2.0 code and encountered an
error running FIRMA. I followed the instructions on this well-
annotated page:
http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/human-exon-array-analysis

However, I get an error message when I try to run the following
command. It appears that I am missing a CDF file with a "monocell"
tag?

messages.author: a5f6afcbe5b17914
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] FIRMA error message after aroma.affymetrix  v1.2.0 install
parts:
Hi,

if you do:

library("aroma.affymetrix");
cdf <- AffymetrixCdfFile$byChipType("HuEx-1_0-st-v2", tags="core");
print(cdf);

cdfM <- getMonocellCdf(cdf, verbose=-20);
print(cdfM);

what do you get?

Also, what does sessionInfo() report?

/Henrik
